title: arctostaphylos glauca f. puberula
intro: Arctostaphylos glauca f. puberula, commonly known as puberulent green manzanita, is a shrub plant native to the southwestern United States. It is a type of manzanita, a genus of plants in the heath family (Ericaceae). The health benefits of Arctostaphylos glauca f. puberula include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as fever, sore throats, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
